A
a 6.0N force at a perpendicular distance of 4.0m from the pivot
B
a 7.0N force at a perpendicular distance of 6.0m from the pivot
C
a 10N force at a perpendicular distance of 4.0m from the pivot
D
a 12N force at a perpendicular distance of 3.0m from the pivot
